relations.subject: Alexander Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: In the age of 15 he was sent to the Nagy-Enyed (now Aiud) Calvinist college of nobility, graduated therefrom in 1807

relations.subject: Alexander Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: graduated therefrom in 1807 and became teacher at the college.

relations.subject: Alexander Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: In 1816-18 he studied with a scholarship for learning English at Göttingen

relations.subject: Alexander Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: took also theology and Arabic under Eichhorn.

relations.subject: Alexander Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: met there on 16th July —> Moorcroft, who prompted him to study Tibetan and let him borrow the Alphabetum Tibetanum of Georgi.

relations.subject: Alexander Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: His main teacher was lama Sangye Phuntsok (Saṅs.rgya Phun-tshogs).

relations.subject: Alexander Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: In May 1838 he became the Librarian of the Asiatic Society.
